shared_elements: human figures in profile with patterned curly hair and beards
continuous horizontal narrative frieze with ground line
figures moving in a single direction across the field
human figure holding a long staff/pole-like object
low-relief carving with incised interior detail (hair, musculature, fleece/mane)
justification: Both are continuous low-relief friezes of profile human figures accompanying overlapping quadrupeds in file along a ground line, with the same conventions for patterned curled hair and beards, incised animal coats and muscular contours, and figures carrying long staffs. The subjects differ sharply, however: A shows a violent scene with a wheeled chariot, plunging horses and sprawling fallen bodies, while B shows an orderly, static procession of men leading horned rams past a stylised tree.
